items.reason: Targets API 35 (Wear rule); no USE_EXACT_ALARM; every permission has a stated use; heart rate stays on the watch (never sent); the health foreground service falls back if refused; no billing, ads, health claims or WhatsApp/Meta/ASCI content on the watch; Play policy status clean. Not checkable from the repo: the Data safety form (the screen diary goes to the phone on request) and the Console declarations for the health foreground service and health.READ_HEART_RATE; no machine file holds them.
This is the Wear OS app; there is no Apple Watch app (the website claim is already FN-A3-website-2-02).

Icon is our own logo made by our branding script; the Manrope font files carry the OFL notice in their metadata; no pictures, clips, music or voices on the watch. The watch ships Google open-source libraries (Apache) with no licence notices anywhere: same fault as FN-L12-phone-native-02. Rights to the MettleUp name cannot be judged from code.
